--- text
x🇫🇷|y
--- keys
Left
--- expect
x|🇫🇷y
--- note
A flag is two Regional Indicator symbols (U+1F1EB U+1F1F7), each a surrogate
pair, together one grapheme cluster under UAX#29 rules GB12/GB13: do not break
between regional indicators when an even number of them precede the boundary.
The caret starts just after the flag (offset 5). One ArrowLeft must cross all
four UTF-16 code units back to just after 'x' (offset 1). find-cluster-break's
backward walk counts the indicators before the break and refuses to stop at
offset 3, which would sit inside the single cluster and paint half a flag.
